description: This file defines the class ADOdbLoadBalancer and related classes, implementing a load balancer for database connections in PHP. It manages multiple database connections, supports load balancing, sticky sessions, and executing SQL across clusters. The classes are used to abstract and manage read/write splitting and load distribution among multiple database servers.
external_files: ADONewConnection (function or class not defined here, likely from the ADODB PHP library)

classes.name: ADOdbLoadBalancer
classes.description: A class to manage and load balance multiple database connections, supporting load distribution, sticky sessions, session variables, and executing queries across multiple connections.

classes.name: ADOdbLoadBalancerConnection
classes.description: Represents a database connection with configuration details, manages the underlying ADODB connection object, and supports custom connection test callbacks.

methods.name: setSessionInitSQL
methods.description: Defines SQL queries to be executed immediately after establishing a new database connection.

methods.name: addConnection
methods.description: Adds a new database connection to the pool without establishing it immediately.

methods.name: removeConnection
methods.description: Removes a connection from the pool by its index.

methods.name: getConnectionByWeight
methods.description: Selects a connection index based on load balancing weights for the specified type.

methods.name: getLoadBalancedConnection
methods.description: Returns a connection index considering sticky sessions and load balancing.

methods.name: getConnectionById
methods.description: Returns an ADODB connection object by connection ID, establishing it if necessary.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns an active ADODB connection object of the specified type, handling connection failures.

methods.name: setSessionVariable
methods.description: Sets a session variable that persists across connections, optionally executes immediately.

methods.name: executeSessionVariables
methods.description: Executes stored session variables on a given ADODB connection.

methods.name: clusterExecute
methods.description: Executes an SQL query on all or selected connections in the cluster, optionally returning all results.

methods.name: isReadOnlyQuery
methods.description: Determines whether a SQL query is read-only based on its syntax.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to execute a SQL query, dispatching it to write or read-only connections as needed.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Intercepts method calls and delegates them to the appropriate ADODB connection object based on query type.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Proxies property access to the current ADODB object.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets properties on all connected ADODB objects.
